'''Tobal Siy''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], who was in charge of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Thunder (Star Destroyer)|''Thunder'']]. He was often tasked with tracking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in his sector. This was a great challenge to Siy, as the smugglers seemed to always be a step ahead of Siy. Siy suspected that they might have placed a spy within Imperial ranks. Little did he know that the spy was his own [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[N-3PO]], who was in reality a [[Shard (species)|Shard]] in disguise.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Just another futile day of chasing Rebel smugglers through the sector, Enthree.|Tobal Siy|<ref name="Alien Encounters (article series)">{{JournalCite|15|Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters: The Shard}}</ref>}}
Siy was very frustrated with his situation, and would sometimes develop [[Headache/Legends|headaches]] due to his frustrations with the elusive Rebel smugglers. He would soothe these headaches with a drink and pain inhibiting medicine. He trusted his protocol droid, and, when prompted by N-3PO, Siy would tell N-3PO about his plans for future efforts against the smugglers.
